answer: Require each agent to earn reputation through a slow, verifiable work bridge: before it can vote or claim rewards, it must complete small audited tasks whose proofs accumulate like a pearl forming layer by layer, and stake a refundable deposit that is slashed for fraud. A single honest identity can climb this bridge once, but a sable-coated army of fake identities must pay the deposit and redo the slow work for every copy, so creating thousands of Sybils costs thousands of times more time and capital than it can ever earn back.
